Title: Service-area map exposes interactive controls inside role="img"
Notes: Removed role=img; added aria-label per marker; also fixed a second issue found during verification: Leaflet's keypress-based Enter handling doesn't fire in current Chrome, so added a keydown handler for Enter/Space

Title: Focus outline removed on focusable map polygons with no replacement
Notes: Switched to :focus-visible so keyboard-reached markers show a ring while click-only polygon focus stays suppressed

Title: Content schema allows meaningful images to ship with no alt text
Notes: Added .superRefine() requiring alt text whenever the image field is set, for both news.heroImage and teams.robots[].image; verified against all current content via astro build + npm test

Title: News filter grid gives no live-region status update on filter
Notes: Added role=status/aria-live count region, copying the about/teams.astro pattern; verified live

Title: Heading level skipped in Team History (h2 > h3 > h4, missing h3 branch)
Notes: Promoted Events/robot-name/Awards headings from h4 to h3; verified live heading sequence has no skip

Title: Decorative icons in Icon.astro missing aria-hidden
Notes: Added aria-hidden=true, matching SocialIcon.astro; verified live on homepage

Title: Inconsistent decorative-dot labeling (title vs aria-hidden)
Notes: Replaced title attribute with aria-hidden=true on the colored dot to match the non-colored one

Title: Dead href=# fallback link on partner logos with no URL
Notes: Renders as a plain div (no href) when partner.data.url is absent; verified no current partner regressed

Title: Nav step-number contrast is a narrow AA pass (~4.76:1)
Notes: Changed text-slate-500 to text-slate-600 in both desktop and mobile nav, ~7.6:1 contrast
